title: ftpenrich action
description: Replaces the body with the content of the first file of an FTP directory that the options select (a content enricher that polls); sets file.name and Content-Type. The file is then deleted or moved to the folder move. Without a file the message passes on unchanged, or fails with abortMode.

path.title: Address
path.description: From the URI: ftp:[//][user@]host[:port]/directory. The directory is below the login directory; after a double slash (host//dir) it is absolute

userName.title: User name
userName.description: User to log in as; anonymous if empty

disconnect.title: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Close the connection after each use; false keeps it open between uses, until it is idle for 30 seconds

passiveMode.title: Passive mode
passiveMode.description: Passive mode is the only one supported; false is rejected

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds to connect and log in; also for a stalled transfer

recursive.title: Recursive
recursive.description: Also look in subdirectories, except those starting with a dot and the folders move and moveFailed

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: Only the file with this name; not with include or exclude

include.title: Include
include.description: Regular expression the file name must match; "" for any

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Regular expression the file name must not match; "" for none

binary.title: Binary
binary.description: Keep the content as bytes instead of text

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: Charset of the files: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 or US-ASCII

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of the files; by name if empty

maxMessagesPerPoll.title: Files per poll
maxMessagesPerPoll.description: Accepted for compatibility; one file enriches the message

delete.title: Delete
delete.description: Delete the file once it is consumed, instead of moving it

move.title: Move to
move.description: Folder the file is moved to once read, below the directory (or absolute); "" leaves it

moveFailed.title: Move failed to
moveFailed.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

autoCreate.title: Auto create
autoCreate.description: Accepted for compatibility; a missing directory holds no files

readLock.title: Read lock
readLock.description: changed: only take a file that has not changed for a second

abortMode.title: Abort mode
abortMode.description: Fail the message if there is no file, instead of passing it on unchanged
